## API stabilisation

v0.8.0 is the first step towards 1.0: the public API is cleaned up so it can be frozen, governance now holds on every execution path, and MCP tools are governed like any other tool.

**This release has breaking changes.** Most are one-line replacements: see the [migration guide](https://datallmhub.github.io/agentflow4j/migration-0.8/).

### Governance
- **Streaming is governed.** `invokeStream` now enforces `ApprovalGate`, `StatePolicy` and checkpoints, and stops on interrupts. In 0.7 a gated node ran without approval when the graph was streamed.
- **Approvals on durable stores.** A run resumed after an approval can be checkpointed again on the JDBC and Redis stores. In 0.7 the next checkpoint failed with `CheckpointSerializationException` unless the internal approval key had been registered by hand.
- **MCP tools.** `ExecutorAgent.Builder.toolProviders(...)` accepts Spring AI's MCP `ToolCallbackProvider`: MCP tools go through `ToolPolicy`, the tool-call audit and listener hooks, and tools added by a server at runtime are picked up.

### Lifecycle hooks
`AgentListener` gains `onCheckpoint`, `onToolCall`, `onApprovalRequired` and `onBudgetExceeded`, fired from both `invoke` and `invokeStream`. They are default methods: existing listeners keep compiling.

### API changes
- `RunOptions` and `ResumeOptions` replace the `invoke` / `resume` / `resumeWithApproval` overloads; a run can now combine a run id and a timeout.
- `ErrorPolicy.RETRY_ONCE`, `RetryPolicy.retryOn` and `RetryPredicates` are removed in favour of `RetryPolicy.once()` and `FailureClassifier`.
- Checkpoint DTOs and `Node.AgentNode` are no longer public.
- New `@Experimental` marker on APIs outside the compatibility guarantee.

### Install (JitPack)
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.github.datallmhub.agentflow4j</groupId>
    <artifactId>agentflow4j-starter</artifactId>
    <version>v0.8.0</version>
</dependency>
```
